subject: AWS Marketplace: product tile & procurement snippets (procurement follow-up)
messages:
From: Jessica Martinez <jessica@acmeretail.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmeretail.com
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing — product tile & procurement collateral

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Procurement asked for a short checklist we can attach to our internal approval ticket so they can triage whether the offer is catalog-ready. Specifically they want:
- Exact SKU/usage language we plan to show in the tile
- Billing/pricing snippet for legal (per-seat vs. usage)
- Any supporting artifacts (SOC2 excerpt, data residency note)

Can you share a one-page summary and the hero tile options you recommend? Also looping in legal (legal@acmeretail.com) in case there are contract-specific asks.

Best,
Jessica
Director, Cloud Procurement
Acme Retail

Attachment: acme_procurement_requirements.pdf (summary of Acme's internal checklist)

From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Martinez <jessica@acmeretail.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing — product tile & procurement collateral

Hi Jessica — really appreciate the clear asks. Attaching a short one-pager and three hero tile options. Quick notes inline:

- SKU/usage language: we recommend the SKU read as `redwood-inference:compute-hours` with clear examples under the tile (e.g., "1 GPU-hour = approx. 100k tokens for base LLMs"). We can shorten for tile view and expand on the pricing page.
- Billing: two suggested snippets for procurement: a) "Usage-based billing by GPU-minute (pay-as-you-go)" b) "Committed capacity monthly plan (reserved GPU hours)" — both included in the pricing matrix.
- Compliance artifacts: SOC 2 summary + data residency note included; full SOC2 report can be shared under NDA.

Next step: Kimberly and Aditya will pick the hero tile variant and finalize the short procurement snippet for you to paste into your ticket.

Thanks,
Sean
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments: hero_tile_options.png, pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: AWS Marketplace tile options & procurement copy (internal — pick variant)

Sean / Aditya — forwarding Jessica's procurement asks. My quick read: pick Variant B for hero tile (concise benefit + clear CTA) and simplify SKU line for the tile to "redwood-inference:tokenized-usage" with the detailed mapping on the pricing page.

Draft procurement snippet (one-liner for their ticket):
"Redwood Inference — hosted LLM inference (usage-based or reserved capacity). Pricing shown as GPU-hour equivalent; we can provide a cost estimate for your expected monthly token volume. SOC2 Type II evidence available on request; data residency options in US/EU/APAC."

Marissa — adding you because marketing might want a slightly different CTA copy for the tile.

-Kim
Head of Marketplace Enablement

On Sep 1, 2027, at 10:05 AM, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Jessica — really appreciate the clear asks....

From: Jessica Martinez <jessica@acmeretail.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmeretail.com, legal@acmeretail.com
Date: 2027-09-02T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing — product tile & procurement collateral

Perfect, thanks Kim and Sean. Variant B looks like the best fit visually. A couple of narrow asks from procurement/legal: please confirm
1) Whether the billing snippet can be copy-pasted into our internal PO system without additional legal wording
2) If the SOC2 summary is sufficient for initial approval or whether procurement needs the full report now

If possible, can you provide the final one-liner (ready for PO) and the minimal list of documents to attach? We want to close this week.

Regards,
Jessica

Attachment: acme_internal_ticket_template.docx (not attached here, referenced)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Martinez <jessica@acmeretail.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing — product tile & procurement collateral

Hi Jessica — thanks for the fast turnaround. Final artifacts below (we've optimized language so it can slot into a PO or internal ticket):

1) Ready-to-copy PO line (one-liner):
"Redwood Inference — Hosted LLM inference (usage-based billing by GPU-hour equivalent). See pricing matrix for estimated cost per token; committed monthly plans available for discounts."

2) Minimal docs to attach for initial approval:
- SOC2 Type II summary (high level) — sufficient for initial procurement review
- Pricing matrix (pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx) — shows usage vs. committed options
- Hero tile (Variant B) image for catalog entry (hero_tile_options.png)

3) Legal note: full SOC2 can be shared under NDA; contract redlines usually handled during PO stage. If Legal needs specific clause language, we can loop in contracts but in most cases the above is enough to move to PO.

Jessica — let me know if you want us to open the HubSpot deal (I can create a partner co-sell record and add a DocuSign draft) — would speed procurement sign-off.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Product Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments listed: pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx, hero_tile_options.png
